name: coup-de-grace-prepare-4-paid-critical-4-doubles-damage
notes: Coup de Grace (5qWWpkgQLl, NORM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 4, printed power 4): "Prepare 4. [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4. (If combat damage would be dealt by a source with critical 4, double that damage unless an opponent discards four cards.)" Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Champion holds 4 preparation counters; player 2 pays Prepare 4 (all four), attacks player 1's champion, and player 1 is then offered 'Discard 4 to prevent critical?' (that offer only exists because the attack gained critical 4) and declines: 4 power is doubled to 8 damage. Asserted exactly: counters 4 -> 0 right after YES, intent tagged PREPARED, then CRITICAL_4 on attack, 8 damage dealt. Before the fix the YES answer was rejected ('Invalid selection') because no Prepare decision was ever queued.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The CardEditor ability row for this card never queued the fixed Prepare cost: no $cardActivatedAbilities['5qWWpkgQLl:0'] entry existed (or, for the Strike from the Mist stub, it was an empty '(engine)' body), so OnCardActivated() queued no 'Pay Prepare N?' decision and wasPrepared was never YES. Live state dump on HEAD 47028d36 before the fix: after the last reserve payment the decision queue went straight to the attack-target / ally-target choice (no YESNO), preparation counters stayed untouched, and answering YES was rejected as 'Invalid selection' (or silently ignored) -- so the card's 'if prepared' rider was unreachable. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['5qWWpkgQLl:0'] (GAQueueFixedPrepare(player, 4)) in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php queues the YES/NO and the generic DeclarePrepareCost; the generic GA_TagPreparedAttack then tags PREPARED, which the generated onAttack (now re-gated on the ASSASSIN class) reads to add CRITICAL_4.
